Team / ACME finance team —

Quick note ahead of tomorrow's forecast snapshot: finance asked for a short reconciliation of opportunities we intend to count toward July quarter bookings. I pulled a working snapshot (attached) and flagged deals that look like they need stage reconciles or owner confirmation.

What I need from each of you by EOD Wednesday (2029-07-17):
- Owners to confirm "commit" status in HubSpot for any opportunity in Negotiation / Contract / Legal. If not ready to commit, set stage to the appropriate pre-commit stage and add a one-line rationale.
- If an opportunity is being double-counted or rolled forward, mark it and add expected close quarter.
- For any deals > $100k with delivery or compliance caveats, add a short risk note in the notes field.

Attachments: pipeline_snapshot_Q3_20290715.xlsx (workbook) — includes Stage, ARR, Owner, Last Touch, and suggested commit flag.

ACME finance — earliest ask: can you confirm whether you want us to include deals with conditional PoCs in this count? We currently have three large PoC deals in Negotiation that may be borderline.

I'll host a 20-minute standup tomorrow at 10:30 PT to run through the high-risk list if helpful.

Thanks,
Markus
Markus Klein
VP, North America Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Hi Markus —

Thanks for the snapshot and the clear ask. For this reconciliation ACME Finance wants the booking sheet to include only opportunities with signed commercial terms or an internally approved PO. Conditional PoCs that do not have a procurement commitment should be listed separately but not counted toward the pipe-to-quota number.

Please produce a separate subtotal for:
- Committed (signed/PO)
- Near-term (pending signatures, clear exec approval)
- Conditional PoC (trial-only, no procurement approval)

Can you also add a quick column indicating whether legal review or security questionnaires remain outstanding — that impacts whether a deal is eligible for inclusion.

Sarah
